newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: NBT says gets okay for Softwoods sale.
newsitem.headline: NBT says gets okay for Softwoods sale.

text.p: North Borneo Timbers Bhd (NBT) said on Thursday it has received approval from the international trade and industry ministry to sell its entire stake in a timber firm.
The proposed disposal of Sabah Softwoods Sdn Bhd will face its final hurdle at a shareholders' extraordinary general meeting on Friday, the company said in a statement.
Commodities and timber firm NBT plans to sell 40 percent owned Softwoods for 150 million ringgit, resulting in an extraordinary gain of 87.44 million ringgit.
NBT stock rose 50 cents to 38.0 ringgit on Thursday trading on volume of 1.3 million shares traded.
